correctness.rationale: The unrestricted area objective for a centered symmetric polygon is 4 h_P(u)h_P(v)/abs(det(u,v)). With one normal fixed, its quotient is linear-fractional on every normal-fan cone; positivity of denominator forces a minimum at an edge-normal ray, with singular rays excluded. Applying this twice reduces the global minimization to three edge-direction pairs. A three-generator zonotope has area 4(X+Y+Z), and the tight pair a,b has exact area 4(T+YZ/X); the cyclic minimization gives 4(T+XYZ/M^2). The 4/3 upper bound and affine-regular equality follow from x y/(1+x+y) <= 1/3 for 0<x,y<=1. For determinant ratio r the monotone third variable gives the sharp deficit 2(1-r)/(3(2+r)), with family a=(1,0), b=(0,1), c=(-1,r) attaining equality. The symbolic rational checker replays these identities on actual package bytes.

value.rationale: The extremal enclosing-parallelogram problem is classical, and the recent cited source motivates finer geometry than the universal 4/3 bound. This yields a full, exact affine-invariant area profile and a finite three-candidate global optimizer for every centrally symmetric hexagon, as well as a sharp deficit-to-determinant-balance stability law. It is a natural complete classification of an approximation invariant over a nontrivial family, not a bare recomputation of Petty equality or an arbitrary parameter slice.
